diagnostics.reason: The actual geometry shows fixed with released=false after the footer passed the viewport; the test expected the footer-release state. Treat as an observed nonblocking sticky/occlusion UX defect, not as evidence of an unapproved link. Fix attribution requires the sticky observer timeline, not a baseline change.

policy: Only listed cosmetic/frozen-presentation groups are diagnostics. Mixed files are not blanket-quarantined. C and F are NOT waived. Legacy npm test and full no-write wrapper remain available; not rerun by this narrow gate. Material unknowns remain required blockers in release-gate.json.
